text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is seeking approval to amend the existing by-law authorizing the installation of speed humps of Langley Avenue to accommodate one additional speed hump.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the installation of one additional speed hump on Langley Avenue between Carlaw Avenue and Logan Avenue.
